How to judge and record source quality on EDFM — used to fill in {{tl|Article status}}'s <code>source_quality</code> field, and to decide when a claim needs {{tl|Unverified claim}}, {{tl|Estimated information}}, or {{tl|Community observation}} instead of being stated as plain fact.

== Rough tiers (highest to lowest confidence) ==
# '''Direct, current, reproducible testing''' by the article's own author, on the stated game version/mode. State the version tested and the date.
# '''Official Frontier sources''': in-game text, official patch notes, official forum posts from Frontier staff. Cite with <code>&lt;ref&gt;</code> and a link.
# '''Well-established community consensus''', cross-confirmed by multiple independent, experienced sources, without a known Frontier statement either way. Use {{tl|Community observation}} if it hasn't been independently reproduced by this project.
# '''Single-source community claim''', not independently confirmed. Use {{tl|Unverified claim}}. Don't present tier-4 information as tier-1/2.
# '''Estimated/approximate figures''' (e.g. "roughly," derived rather than measured). Use {{tl|Estimated information}} and say how the estimate was derived if possible.

== Version sensitivity ==
''Elite Dangerous'' changes over time, and Legacy has diverged from Live. A source being accurate once doesn't make it accurate now. {{tl|Article status}}'s <code>version</code> and <code>reviewed</code> fields exist specifically so a reader can judge whether a claim might be stale — always fill them in rather than leaving the defaults.

== What this project will not do ==
* Fabricate plausible-sounding numbers to fill a gap. An honestly marked gap is more useful than a confident-sounding guess.
* Treat a single unverified forum post as equivalent to a reproduced test.
* Treat an AI model, chatbot, generated answer, or AI-produced summary as a source or verification tier.
* Import facts, images, or text from Fandom or other wikis, even with attribution — see [[Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Legal and Trademark Notice]].
